topic: Woke up with a stiff, locked neck
caption:
Woke up unable to turn your head? 😵
Acute wry neck is common and usually settles within a few days.

Skip the forcing — use warmth and gentle movement within comfort. Arm tingling or fever? See a doctor.

📍 Chatswood · Sydney CBD
